target: softmax over negative final guarded candidate cost at temperature 1 percent incumbent cost; all 1128 pair moves plus unchanged incumbent; exhaustive candidate labels
architecture: two typed residual message-passing layers, hidden16, symmetric pair head; MP-OFF separately trained on identical base inputs; hand model adds fixed one/two-hop typed means
features: declared workflow and resources, computed incumbent assignment and its completion times; explicit shared locks, same job/host and operation separation for every pair; no teacher-derived inputs
training: AdamW lr0.001 batch16 epochs30, three seeds per arm; select minimum mean validation served objective including epoch0; no hyperparameter sweep
hand_control: frozen graph1 from mixed_pair_budget_margin_v1; no test calibration
advance: validation mean improves at least 5 percent vs hand rule, all selected model full paths p95<=5ms; regardless of screening, frozen selected models receive live gate
live_gate: 32 fresh workflows times nine frozen models, graph1, oracle and incumbent =384 real HeROsim runs; independent SimPy task completion checks
claim_bar: GNN median paired improvement>=5 percent versus MP-OFF, hand-graph model and graph1, positive bootstrap lower bounds, all GNN draws p95<=5ms; n32 pilot, no powered publication claim
timing: seven repeats, full incumbent+features+inference+selected pair refinement+guard; exclude load/compile; report p95 of case medians
logging: offline Weights and Biases; no upload; CPU only; preserve all weights and contracts
stop: No scaling or additional architecture search on this holdout if pilot misses validation/live bars
